name: rd-decay-demo
description: Tiny VCell FV reaction-diffusion demo: a uniform pool of species A decays to species B (A -> B; k*A) on a small 3D Cartesian mesh. No diffusion. Emits per-snapshot mean/total concentration plus time-axis bookkeeping.

duration.description: Total simulated time in seconds. The wrapper pre-runs the full PDE solve and then streams snapshots through update().

output_time_step.description: Snapshot cadence written by the solver.

interval.description: PBG update interval between snapshots. Match output_time_step to advance one snapshot per step.

init_A.description: Initial concentration of species A (Antimony-style scalar or spatial expression in x,y,z).
